showcases.title: Set your local council
showcases.brief: You're designing how someone sets their local council in the GOV.UK app. It starts from the Your local services part of Home (the council card there, or a link to set it). They type their postcode, such as BS15 3LL; choose their address from a short list (1, 2 and 3 Malpass Court, BS15 3LL); see a screen confirming the address they chose and that their council is South Gloucestershire Council, with a button to confirm; then they're back on Home, which now shows a card with their next bin collections. The postcode and address they gave should show again on the confirm screen. You don't mind the exact wording.
